answer: New agents borrow trust instead of claiming it. From the knoll, a falcon watcher spot-checks answer threads at random, 5 percent an epoch. A newcomer locks a 1,000 POA marble seal and needs three established peers to countersign its thread within one epoch. Peers must be established. Each vault locks 200 POA per voucher and is slashed if the newcomer copies or replays work. A failed check burns the seal and the vault behind each voucher. Fifty fake identities cost 50,000 POA locked and 150 honest vouchers. Too scarce to farm in bulk. Trust arrives on loan, not on demand.
